description.narrative: Increased transparency in the national parlament in the DRC
Ökad transparens i den det nationella parlamentet i DRK

The project's overall objective is to contribute improving democratic governance in the DRC by strengthening accountability, political inclusion and civic engagement. This is part of a drive to restore trust between citizens and institutions, by developing monitoring tools, producing independent research and creating forums for public discussion.
The specific objectives are:
1. To strengthen the transparency and accountability of public institutions, by consolidating the monitoring of parliamentary activity via Talatala 3.0, structuring the monitoring of the executive via Landila, and supporting the production of analyses on the institutional reforms needed for more effective and inclusive governance.
2. Promoting the participation of women and young people in public life, as well as the integration of gender equality into the legislative process, by conducting targeted research into the dynamics of exclusion, developing the Talatala GenderWatch dedicated web page and building the capacity of young researchers through the Ebuteli Fellowship programm
